product_one_liner.value: Cast AI automates and optimizes Kubernetes and AI infrastructure for engineering and platform teams to improve reliability, performance, resource utilization and cloud costs.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL is a custom-quote contact page, with no published plans or prices; treated as false under the requested bare-contact-form rule. Public rates are separately available on AWS Marketplace.

employee_band.notes: Company profile reports 201–500 employees; the available workforce count is 360.

eng_blog.notes: Mike Norgate describes the production snapshot-storage redesign; Augustinas Stirbis describes internal infrastructure-as-code, CI, testing, GitOps and on-call practices. Their profiles establish engineering roles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live application page: Senior Applied ML Engineer | Kimchi (Model Router), dated 2026-10-15.

model_provider.notes: Cast AI explicitly describes serving Qwen2.5:14B through its AI Enabler and selecting it from the product model catalog. This establishes a publicly used/supported model, not an exclusive provider for every Cast AI feature.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Center lists ISO/IEC 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 2 and a PCI DSS Attestation of Compliance. GDPR contractual commitments are not counted as a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced January 12, 2026: strategic investment by Pacific Alliance Ventures; funding database labels it Series C-II. The investment amount was not disclosed, so amount_usd is omitted. The reported $1 billion-plus figure is valuation, not funding raised.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 12, 2026 investment falls within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live application page: Business Development Representative | French Speaking, dated 2026-10-16.

launched_6mo.notes: Kimchi Coding reached general availability on July 15, 2026, within 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: VP of Marketing Joe Roualdes announced his departure from Cast AI and move to Condor on June 9, 2026, within 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Sales Ops Analyst posting names Salesforce and the other sales-intelligence/operations tools; it is historical and no longer accepting applications, so it is a stack signal rather than proof all remain deployed. The current BDR posting names LinkedIn, Clay and Apollo.
